text.en: Most pet owners praise the vets, veterinary nurses, and receptionists for their attentive listening, gentle manner, and prompt emergency triage. Named clinicians like Emma and receptionists like Natalie receive praise for going above and beyond. However, a couple of reviewers felt staff were indifferent or dismissive during distressing situations.

Clients consistently report gentle and patient handling during routine dog and cat visits, noting that pets feel calm in the uncrowded practice. Nevertheless, two reviewers reported distressing outcomes, including an unresponsive kitten following labour complications and refusal to assist an injured stray without formal registration.

title.en: Reasonable routine fees and testing disputes

text.en: Several reviewers describe standard consultation charges as fair and appreciate cost-conscious food recommendations from veterinary surgeons. Conversely, critical clients felt fees were excessive in emergencies and objected to being required to pay for specialized blood tests, such as Brucella screening for imported rescue dogs.

q.en: Does Blacks Vets Quinton accommodate urgent cases?

a.en: Reviewers note that the practice accommodates urgent triage during opening hours, directing out-of-hours cases to their partner hospital.

q.en: Is the waiting area quiet and low-stress for pets?

a.en: Yes, clients comment that the waiting room is generally calm and not overcrowded, helping keep animals relaxed.
Routine consultations are viewed as reasonably priced, though owners should expect additional fees for diagnostic laboratory tests.
